passiveFlavor.name: Toxicologist
passiveFlavor.desc: +2 auto damage while the enemy is poisoned.

passiveFlavor.name: Grudge
passiveFlavor.desc: His next auto adds the damage he has soaked since his last strike, divided by 2.

passiveFlavor.name: Arcane Battery
passiveFlavor.desc: Only the Mage banks Charge — +1 each turn (max 5); Lightning Bolt spends it for +3 damage per Charge.

passiveFlavor.name: Dark Bargain
passiveFlavor.desc: Each time a party member dies, a living Warlock permanently gains +1 damage and +1 ability power for the rest of the fight.

passiveFlavor.name: Opening Act
passiveFlavor.desc: While fielded and alive, the Busker draws +1 card at the start of each turn.

passiveFlavor.name: Rage
passiveFlavor.desc: Hits harder the lower his HP: +2 damage in his first rage band, another +2 in the second (net +2/+4). The thresholds rise with the enemy's attack.

passiveFlavor.name: Feral Bond
passiveFlavor.desc: Her first strike after her Boar falls tears for ×3 damage.

passiveFlavor.name: Stunt Double
passiveFlavor.desc: She dives in front of any blow that would be lethal to a teammate, taking the hit — her own wards and HP — in their place.

passiveFlavor.name: Riposte Master
passiveFlavor.desc: She always counterattacks: every hit that strikes her (fully blocked hits included) is answered for her live auto damage — no card, no timer.

passiveFlavor.name: Last Stand
passiveFlavor.desc: Once per fight, a killing blow — a hit or a Blood cost — leaves him at 1 HP instead of dropping him.
